resources.string: Gesture trainer

Learn to make gestures so that SandFly recognizes them every time. Choose a group. For each gesture, SandFly explains how to make it. Then you make it %1$d times, and after each try you hear whether it worked. After the last try, the screen shows how precise your gestures were and what to change.

The gesture trainer needs Android 13 or later, where SandFly recognizes gestures itself.
Back-and-forth and angle gestures are left out, because Recognize swipes before lifting is on in Gestures settings.
Two-finger swipes are left out, because with your gesture settings they scroll in apps.

It is easiest like this: put the index and middle finger next to each other, they may touch. Put the thumb and the ring finger a few centimetres away from them, on either side. Then bring all four fingertips together to one point, as if picking something up.

Your edges (Edge width) are %1$d mm wide, and your corners (Corner size) are squares of %2$d mm. You can change both in Gestures settings.

Bigger corners make corner taps easier, but a tap on a button near a corner, such as Back at the top left or a menu at the top right, may then run the corner gesture instead. If you don\'t use corner gestures, keep the default size.
